verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents a public RESTful JSON API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 YAML spec, a Postman collection, official SDKs in many languages, and a self-serve sandbox. Probes confirm the docs are reachable, including llms.txt and a markdown API reference. The OpenAPI probe 404s only on guessed JSON paths, which does not contradict the documented YAML download. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the API end-to-end, and the spec is not discoverable at standard machine-readable OpenAPI paths.
